### WELCOME TO

## Loch Shiel Cruises

## Bird Watching, Wildlife & Historical Cruises on Loch Shiel, Glenfinnan, by Fort William, Scotland

### Unique "Eagle-Watch" cruises aboard the historic MV Sileas on the beautiful sheltered waters of Loch Shiel

## The M.V. Sileas

#### Join us on an unforgettable cruise aboard the M.V. Sileas on the stunning Loch Shiel.

Join us on a cruise where it is possible to view Golden Eagles, White Tailed Eagles, Red Throated Divers, Hen Harriers, Red Deer plus a wide variety of other wildlife, while learning the History and Geology of this special, remote and unspoiled part of the Highlands of Scotland.

Accessible only by boat, Loch Shiel is one of Scotland's most historically significant and unspoiled natural treasures.

Carved out by retreating glaciers over successive ice ages, this 18 mile long freshwater loch has changed relatively little since then and can truly be called a last wild place.

![Lochshielcruise2](https://www.highlandcruises.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/Lochshielcruise2.jpg)

![Lochshielcruise3](https://www.highlandcruises.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/Lochshielcruise3.jpg)

#### Friendly and knowledgeable crew

Now you can cruise the magnificent and historical scenery of Loch Shiel in the company of a friendly and knowledgeable crew, with live commentary on the history and wildlife of this beautiful region.

Sileas has a bar, coffee and tea and light refreshments on board. Meals and snacks are available ashore at each end of Loch Shiel. Your well behaved dogs are welcome to join you on board.

Sileas has Marine Coastguard Agency approval to carry 50 passengers, with covered and open seating on deck and a saloon below decks. Binoculars and guidebooks are available for your use on board.
